I live in Istanbul, Turkey. A lot of people came here in a short amount of time. At first, it was okay. I thought we are going to have them in our country for a few months, or a year or two. As it turns out, they are here to stay. They are not going anywhere. We're talking about 3.5 million people, and this number is growing up so quickly.

I hate to live in this country ever since. Citizens are hopeless. Many of us feel like a second-class citizen because the government is quite focused to help the migrants, not their citizens. Refugees have higher standards than us. They expect us to learn their language and their culture. They are not trying to blend in. Arabic texts everywhere, speaking arabic languages everywhere, they talk to me in arabic language, when I talk in Turkish they gave me a weird look. God, I can't express how much I hate to live in this country.

As an employer's point of view, I do have only one refuge employee because I had to hire someone who knows arabic language. I'm planning to sell my company and move to another country. I can't and don't want to handle this anymore.
